inputs.drivers: Reactor restarts and new builds; energy security; conversion and enrichment bottlenecks; long-term contracting; supply concentration.
inputs.invalidation: Project restarts, secondary supply, policy delays, contract-price lag, or operational disruptions.
inputs.seed_claim: Nuclear expansion is exposing bottlenecks in uranium mining, conversion, and enrichment, giving strategically positioned contracted suppliers potential leverage.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed cites IEA fuel-cycle concentration and tight conversion capacity plus Cameco's nine-year India contract for nearly 22 million pounds beginning in 2027.
inputs.value_chain: Uranium miners; conversion and enrichment; nuclear fuel services.

objective: Research one nuclear fuel-cycle bottleneck investment idea.
